{{Quote|&hellip;and that's ''Amni Ponnar'', somehow caught in the middle of the fight!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="WJW" />}}
'''Amni Ponnar''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived at her [[Parent/Legends|parent's]] [[Ponnar homestead|homestead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], her life was put in danger after [[Ponnar|her father's]] plan to make the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] go to war over [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] turned wrong. She was saved by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] and his new young [[Padawan/Legends|trainee]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Back to her home, she learned of her father's treachery from Kenobi and noticed that the locals had followed them. However, Kenobi defused the escalation of violence and went his way, leaving Amni and her mother to settle accounts with her father.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ben Kenobi and Luke ''saved'' me, daddy&hellip; I was on my way back from Anchorhead with the supplies when I ran into some sort of fight between the Jawas and the Tusken Raiders. Then they ''attacked'' me...|Amni Ponnar, to [[Ponnar|her father]]|<ref name="WJW" />}}
Amni Ponnar was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]] in the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], she lived with her [[Ponnar|father]] and [[Ponnar (Mrs)|mother]] at the [[Ponnar homestead|family homestead]], situated in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. Although her father considered him to be a "crazy old man," Ponnar was an acquaintance of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]],<ref name="WJW" /> secretly a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] in hiding who lived out beyond the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> She was also familiar with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="WJW" /> a nineteen-year-old who resided at [[Owen Lars/Legends|his uncle's]] [[Lars homestead/Legends|home]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> on the [[Great Chott salt flat/Legends|Great Chott salt flat]].<ref name="ITW Trilogy">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

In 0 BBY, Amni's father sought to expand his farm at the expense of the local [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. Unbeknownst to his wife and daughter, he stole all the [[Hubba gourd/Legends|hubba gourds]] that grew on a cliff while they were still growing. Since those hubba gourds were the main staple [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] of both [[Species/Legends|species]], Amni's father hoped the two groups would fight over the vanished [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]]. With the Jawa and Tusken Raider clans wiping out one another, the farmer could farm beyond the bounds of his current property.<ref name="WJW" />

[[File:Amni_ambushed.png|thumb|left|250px|Amni Ponnar caught in a fight between [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]]]
However, some of the locals noticed Ponnar's [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] while he was stripping the hubba gourds clean. When Amni was sent to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] to purchase supplies, she found herself in the middle of a fight between Jawas and Tusken Raiders on her way back, and the fighters recognized the Ponnar family speeder. The girl was rescued by the timely arrival of Kenobi, who was headed to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] with Luke Skywalker, who was now his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]]. The two men returned Amni safely to her homestead, where the farmer Ponnar gave them a lukewarm reception.<ref name="WJW" />

Suspecting that Ponnar might have something to do with the natives' hostile behavior, Kenobi pretended to wash off the sand from his clothes so he could investigate the house. Kenobi found the stolen hubba gourds behind a sliding wall and exposed the treachery in front of the homestead residents. The young Amni was appalled to learn of her father's machinations. When Ponnar threatened Kenobi with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Luke Skywalker reacted by swinging [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|his father's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the gun, cutting through its barrel before the farmer had the occasion to shoot. Immediately afterwards, Amni realized that the fighting Jawas and Tusken Raiders had followed them home and were about to [[Attack on the Ponnar homestead|assault]] the place. Since the farm's occupants were clearly outnumbered, Kenobi defused the situation by redistributing the stolen hubba gourds. Once the natives had left, Amni and her mother waved their heroes of the day goodbye, while her father was crushed by the shame of his devious scheme.<ref name="WJW" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Did you see the scorn on the faces of his wife and daughter, Luke? I think that will be punishment enough!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="WJW" />}}
[[File:Ponnar_family.png|thumb|right|250px|Following the [[Hubba gourd/Legends|hubba gourds]] incident, Amni Ponnar resented [[Ponnar|her father's]] conduct.]]
By 0 BBY, Amni Ponnar was a juvenile female with fair skin and [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She had a speckled face and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], which she wore in twin bunches. Despite her young age, Amni's parents deemed her responsible enough to travel through the Jundland Wastes on her own, and she was also capable of piloting the family landspeeder herself. While she had been attacked by the Jawas and the Tusken Raiders, Amni was still shocked at the idea that her father would lead them to stand at daggers drawn. Following Kenobi's departure, she looked at her father with contempt, which the Jedi found to be enough of a punishment.<ref name="WJW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amni Ponnar first appeared in ''[[War on the Jundland Wastes]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Mike W. Barr]] and illustrated by [[Bob Molesworth]], which was published in [[2014]] in [[Star Wars Comic 7.1|''Star Wars Comic'' 7.1]].<ref name="WJW" />
